exact: For this UnityPlayer image, the default selector9 descriptor installs the two pinned readers in slots4 and5 through the shared indexed assignment path.
Both readers load exact key[255,0,0], resolve one context+0x80 field5 target and copy its 16-byte window before calling independently pinned whole downstream consumers.
Across the two whole downstream consumers, anonymous dword lanes at offsets0,4,8,12 are conditionally read and no source byte beyond offset15 is read.
